verifiable-quality-gates.why: the whole PR is gate correctness: three scan gates are made to fail closed and match precisely (#145 retention-basis missing/mistyped --map, #153 no-ua JSDoc prose, #147 reference-links link-target resolution, #121 reference-links GATE_REPO_ROOT + unreadable file), each pinned by a test that FAILS when the fix is reverted
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added ISSUE-145/147/121 and ISSUE-153 discrimination cases; all three gate test files + the full suite pass (726 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped)
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: making required gates fail closed and changing retention-basis's provenance-pinned invoke is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0076 covering the four fixes, the honest limits (regex linter, prose-vs-link rule, unreadable-file proven on CI only), and the manifest sha/invoke change
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: each fix is pinned at the level that owns it: a unit/integration test that spawns the real gate against a fixture tree and asserts the exact exit code (0/1/2)
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-based exit-code tests for the missing-map, JSDoc-prose, link-target, env-root and unreadable-file paths
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed for each gate: missing/mistyped/optional map, JSDoc prose vs real code, dangling-vs-resolving link target, env-root, unreadable file
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: node:test cases, each asserting the real exit code and distinctive output
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: ADR-0076 states the honest limits rather than overclaiming: no-ua is still a regex linter (no string parsing), reference-links resolves only link targets (prose keeps the basename rule, or 116 prose tokens would false-positive), and the unreadable-file path is proven on Linux CI and skipped where the OS will not make a file unreadable
skeptical-audit.what: recorded each limit with its evidence state in ADR-0076
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the three-gate delta before the PR, checking the fail-closed changes, the path-containment of the new link resolution, and that the manifest shas match the edited sources
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no user input/auth/session/secret/upload surface; the only path derived from file content (a Markdown link target) is contained with a rel.startsWith('..') check as defensive correctness, not a product security control that would need an @security scenario

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the fixes reuse each gate's existing arg-parse/scan/report structure

arch-encode.why: the fixes are enforced by discrimination tests, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic is written; the retention-basis change hardens the gate that ENFORCES those obligations, which is verifiable-quality-gates territory

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; these are CLI scan gates

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism; the manifest sha/invoke change ships in the 1.3.1 line and is covered by provenance, not by a release-safety mechanism here

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; developer-facing CI gates

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or frontend code is written; the no-ua-sniffing change hardens the gate that ENFORCES feature-detection, which is verifiable-quality-gates territory

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; developer-facing CI gates
